product_metadata.title: Sagino Pillows for Sleeping Queen Size Set of 2, Luxury Hotel Bed Pillows for Side Back Stomach Sleeper- Hypoallergenic Cotton Zippered Cover, Plush Down Alternative Filling and Adjustable Height
features: 【Super Plush Material】: Sa gino pillows are crafted in 3D high quality of microfiber that are extra soft and relaxing. They are the down alternative pillows for sleeping, designed in hotel level comfort-fluffy and luxurious making you easier to fall asleep.

【Breathable & Hypoallergenic】: Side sleeper pillow use 100% cotton pillowcase which is breathable without odor, hypoallergenic, eco-friendly, durable and super soft, protecting pillows from sweat, oil and dead skin cell from your body and allowing you feel the gentle caress of nature while you sleep.

【Fully Adjustable】: Sa gino side sleeping pillow case has a zipper that allows you to see the inside material and adjust volume of the fiber to find your optimal loft to accommodate any sleep position, avoiding sleeping problems like insomnia, turning through out the night, light sleep, headaches and neck pain.
【Machine Washable】: Sleep pillow’s material is fade and stain resistant and it is also machine washable to keep it clean and fluffy, making it always look like new to help you get a restful sleep.

【Multi-Applicable Scenarios】: Sa gino pillows are made in a OEKO-TEX Standard 100% certified factory so no worries about any safety problems. It can be not only bed pillows but also travel pillow, couch pillows, lumbar support pillow for chair, reading pillow and bolster pillow etc..
【Available Sizes】: There're 3 sizes available for you--Standard: 26 x 20 inch; Queen: 30 x 20 inch; King: 36 x 20 inch. You can choose the size you are most used to to get a sweet night!
